commits.headline: fix(launcher): clear AppImageKit's PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
AppImageKit's AppRun binary unconditionally exports PYTHONHOME=$APPDIR/usr/
and PYTHONPATH=$APPDIR/usr/share/pyshared/: before starting the launcher.
CPython initialization uses PYTHONHOME to set sys.prefix, forcing both our
bundled python-build-standalone and any host system python to search for
encodings in $APPDIR/usr/lib/python3.12, which does not exist. The tools then
crash on startup with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'encodings'.

Clear any AppImage-scoped PYTHONHOME and…
